items.subject: Parent settings for Aurelia’s account
items.summary: YouTube reports that a child account named Aurelia was recently created with the “Most of YouTube” setting, which permits nearly all non-18+ content and may expose the child to mature topics.
items.action: Confirm whether you created the Aurelia account. If not, open YouTube or Google Family settings directly, remove or secure the unfamiliar child profile and review recent account activity. If it is yours, review whether “Most of YouTube” is age-appropriate.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether the Aurelia child account is recognised and whether its content setting is appropriate.
